rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound object of knowing; gūḍha (hidden) + sadbhāva (true nature)
main verb indicating manifestation or coming into being

items.question: How does knowing the hidden true nature give rise to omniscience?
premises: There exists a hidden true nature to be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a decisive realization.
Omniscience arises as a result of that realization.
items.inference: Therefore, realization of the hidden true nature produces omniscience.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the immediately preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
